discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 85ba54c1e8. When a Skip names a row that sits before the cursor (one New set already paged past), the cursor now moves back by one. Only the skipped row leaves the pool, and the rows on screen stay put. A test pins your sequence: New set, then a late Skip for Verify, leaves Review/Wrap up/Next step in view, and Undo skip brings Verify back to the front. I also fuzzed 4,000 random verb sequences offline against "a skip hides only its row, more drops only the last row, Undo skip brings its row into view". The fuzzer finds this bug without the fix and finds nothing with it.

Fixed in 202642e: parseStatus now keeps the original path on R/C records (originalPath on the file entry). The webview includes it in unstage actions (unstagePaths helper, used for row, group, and breadcrumb unstage) and passes it to get_git_file_diff so a staged rename reads HEAD at the old path. Covered by a real-repo test that git mv's a file, checks the diff shows the old contents, unstages both paths, and verifies the old path is no longer staged as a deletion.
Fixed in 202642e: numstat records split on the first two tabs only and the remainder is kept as the filename, with a test for a tab-containing name.

Fixed. An entry whose value is an inline scalar, like `disabled: true` or `disabled: false # note`, is now a single line, so an indented comment after it stays with the author. Block scalars (`|`, `>`) and nested values still take their indented continuation lines with them. Test added for both disabling and re-enabling.
